Main.dc.html.title: App shell — sessions panel + chat, live demo

t1.text: App shell — icon rail, workspace sessions, chat with capsules, composer

t2.text: Anatomy, motion and the Max-effort moment

p1.text: Paper: every surface is a cut sheet with a hard offset shadow, so depth comes from stacking, not blur. Motion runs on steps() at 8–12 fps like a stop-motion puppet: capsules boil while working, notes drop in, the YOLO and MAX stamps thump down.

f1.text: Futuristic: a HUD console. Bracket corners, 1 px lines, mono microlabels, one cyan accent with amber for YOLO/Max. Motion is linear and mechanical: a scan line sweeps the working capsule, panels unclip, the reply types itself in.
